answer: RxGate, a verifier, checks each dispensary license against the state board register and matches every serialized unit identifier to one registration before a claim clears. The penalty trigger is a duplicated registration number or one serial scanned at two counters, which suspends the license and forfeits the compliance bond. Registration costs 520 dollars, a scanner 340, an audit 180, so N fakes cost N times 1040 dollars plus N inspections. A raven on the roof, a spiral in the ledger, or the nadir of the quarter changes nothing, since the serial is checked at every dispense.
